title: A finite-length principal quotient has height-one residue factors
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings, with B a Dedekind domain and an A-algebra. Let b ∈ B be nonzero and n ∈ ℕ, and suppose length_A(C) = n in ℕ∞, where C = B/bB has its canonical scalar actions. There exist a B-composition series s of C from zero to C and a function p : Fin(s.length) → HeightOneSpectrum B such that, for every i, the successive quotient s(i+1)/s(i) is B-linearly isomorphic to B/p(i).asIdeal. Here s(i) is regarded as a submodule of s(i+1) through the canonical inclusion.
lean_statement: ∀ (A B : Type*) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsDedekindDomain B] [Algebra A B] (b : B), b ≠ 0 → ∀ n : ℕ, Module.length A (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({b} : Set B)) = (n : ℕ∞) → ∃ s : CompositionSeries (Submodule B (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({b} : Set B))), s.head = ⊥ ∧ s.last = ⊤ ∧ ∃ p : Fin s.length → IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum B, ∀ i : Fin s.length, Nonempty ((↥(s i.succ) ⧸ (s i.castSucc).comap (s i.succ).subtype) ≃ₗ[B] (B ⧸ (p i).asIdeal))
